outcome: Pregnancy complications (gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, infection, preterm premature rupture of membranes)
cohort: Pregnant women with RA (n=96), axSpA (n=78), and healthy controls (n=70)
finding: Pregnant women with RA and axSpA had a higher risk of pregnancy complications, small for gestational age infants, and preterm deliveries compared to healthy controls.
mod_finding: Women with RA had an increased risk of caesarean section compared to healthy controls, while this association was not observed in women with axSpA.
